'''Roast bhillen''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] that could be quartered and was made using [[bhillen]],<ref name="Most Dangerous Foe" /> a type of [[Species/Legends|animal]].<ref name="Slaying Dragons">{{JournalCite|9|Slaying Dragons}}</ref> Around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Vici Ramunee]] entered the [[Cave of Truth]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teya IV]]. Inside she found a well-lit chamber and a spreed of food on a table that included a quarter roast bhillen; however she soon noticed shiny [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Beetle/Legends|beetles]] scuttling out from beneath the bhillen. She turned away from the table and when she turned back she discovered the food, including the roast bhillen had vanished.<ref name="Most Dangerous Foe" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the Human [[Technician/Legends|techician]] [[Deen Voorson]] recounted the story of Ramunee to two fellow members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], [[Mavis]] and [[Tarn (Rebellion)|Tarn]].<ref name="Most Dangerous Foe" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roast bhillen appeared in "[[The Most Dangerous Foe]]," a [[1996]] short story written by [[Angela Phillips]] published by [[West End Games]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Most Dangerous Foe" />
